i2c_bus.label: I²C Bus
i2c_bus.description: The Linux I²C bus number (/dev/i2c-N). 1 on a Raspberry Pi's 40-pin header.

address.label: I²C Address
address.description: The chip's address: 0x40 unless its address jumpers are bridged.

frequency_hz.label: PWM Frequency (Hz)
frequency_hz.description: Servo frame rate, chip-wide. 50 Hz suits analog servos; most digital servos take up to 330 Hz.

channel.label: Channel
channel.description: The HAT's servo header the servo plugs into, 0–15. Derived from the wire to it.

zero_rad.label: Servo Angle at Joint Zero (rad)
zero_rad.description: Where in its travel the servo sits when the joint reads 0.
